release_notes: Windows releases no longer fail when an Authenticode certificate is not configured; the Velopack installer and update feed still publish automatically.
If a trusted Windows signing certificate is added later, the same release workflow signs and verifies installers automatically without another app change.
The first installer may show a Windows SmartScreen warning while releases are unsigned; future in-app Velopack updates remain available after installation.
The Updates button can bootstrap the current Factburst Quiz Manager installer from a development/source copy, then future updates apply and restart in place.
The FactVaultManager Velopack package ID remains unchanged so installed versions stay on one compatible update line.
Build 50's immediate Production-button visibility guard remains included, preventing the legacy header action from flickering after Refresh.
